== Trivia ==
* The [[Mesmer]] in the [[skill icon]] is wearing [[Mesmer Vabbian armor|Vabbian armor]], and is probably the same person that appears on skill icons of [[Wandering Eye]] and [[Power Lock]].
*The skill's name is an idiom meaning that if we do not waste what we have, we will still have it in the future and not lack (want) it.
